customQuestions.question: Why do you want to join Figma? (Please share 3-4 sentences on why you want to join Figma)
customQuestions.orig: Figma's mission of making design accessible and bridging design with engineering has fundamentally redefined modern software development. With my experience building high-throughput, real-time web applications and scalable microservices in TypeScript, Python, and cloud infrastructure, I want to contribute to the robust platform systems that empower millions of creators worldwide. I am inspired by Figma's culture of craft, performance rigor, and community-driven product innovation.
customQuestions.concise: I want to join Figma to build the high-scale infrastructure and developer tools that make collaborative design seamless. With my background in TypeScript, Python, and distributed systems, I am excited to contribute to Figma's high-performance web runtime.
customQuestions.technical: I admire Figma's engineering excellence across browser runtimes, WebAssembly, and real-time multiplayer synchronization. Bringing deep experience in TypeScript, Python microservices, and distributed AWS architectures, I want to build resilient platform capabilities that support Figma's rapid enterprise scale.
customQuestions.metrics: Track record scaling backend systems to support 10M+ daily events, cutting P99 latency by 42%, and maintaining 99.99% system availability. I want to bring this reliability and performance focus to Figma.

customQuestions.question: Why do you want to join Figma? (Please share 3-4 sentences on why you want to join Figma)
customQuestions.orig: Figma has transformed collaborative design, and the Forward Deployed Engineering team sits at the most exciting frontier: connecting enterprise design systems directly to production code and agentic AI workflows. With my hands-on background in full-stack engineering, TypeScript/Python, and developer tool integrations, I want to embed with strategic customers to make tools like Code Connect and MCP seamless in their environments. I thrive in ambiguous, customer-facing technical challenges where I can solve immediate adoption hurdles and turn those lessons into durable platform features.
customQuestions.concise: I want to join Figma's Forward Deployed Engineering team to bridge design systems, production code, and agentic AI tools like MCP. Bringing strong experience in TypeScript, Python, and customer-facing developer platforms, I am excited to embed with strategic enterprise teams to unlock adoption and feed field insights back into Figma's core product.
customQuestions.technical: Figma is pioneering the design-to-code runtime with Code Connect, design token architectures, and agentic workflows via MCP. Bringing deep experience with TypeScript/Python microservices, component libraries, CI/CD toolchains, and enterprise security requirements (SSO, access controls), I want to debug complex integration constraints directly in customer environments and build reusable integration playbooks.
customQuestions.metrics: Proven track record accelerating developer velocity: architected enterprise platforms that reduced time-to-production by 42% and sustained 99.99% availability. I am eager to bring this engineering rigor to Figma's strategic enterprise customers, driving 100% adoption success on design-to-code and AI workflows.
